title: semanticfa: reproduction archive for "semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales"
description: Release of the semanticfa R package repository whose reproduce folder regenerates every number, table, and figure in the paper "semanticfa: An R Package for Response-Free Semantic Factor Analysis of Psychometric Scales" (Yanitski and Westbury, 2026): the worked example with the 50 IPIP Big-Five Factor Markers and the analyses of eight further inventories. The folder holds the master script (reproduce.R), its full console transcript (reproduce.Rout), the archived embeddings, the items of the further inventories with their factors and scoring keys, the outputs, and the figures. See reproduce/README.md. For the Beck Anxiety Inventory and the Taylor Manifest Anxiety Scale the folder holds embeddings and item codes only. The human response files are not redistributed, and the README says where to download them. The script requires version 0.6.0 or later of the semanticfa package.
